scope: 50 physical local X11 Stop trials after completed capture

commands.assertions: 50/50 owner CLI Stop trials cleared durable leases and rejected post-stop input; p95 latency 8.229ms, maximum 8.626ms against 250ms target.

postconditions: Each trial reported durable_lease_cleared and post_stop_input_denied; grants were empty after Stop.
limitations: This is a local Linux X11 Stop benchmark and does not establish cross-platform interruption evidence.
